name: @arcanemachine/pi-session-manager
description: Pi extension hosting fleets of interactive Pi TUI processes in a dedicated tmux server

scripts.format: prettier --write "src/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.ts" AGENTS.md README.md CHANGELOG.md LICENSE.md package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "src/**/*.ts" "tests/**/*.ts" AGENTS.md README.md CHANGELOG.md LICENSE.md package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build

author: Nicholas Moen
